# Plot Ledge

> Plot Ledge is a CRM for plot and property dealers in Pakistan. It replaces Excel
> sheets and WhatsApp screenshots with one record of plots, deals, installments,
> payments, bank slips, receipts and investor profit splits.

Plot Ledge tracks plot inventory, buyer deals, installment schedules, payments and
bank slip records, investor and profit-split ledgers, loans, dealer exchanges, and
exportable reports for property dealers and housing societies.

- [Home](https://www.plotledge.com/): overview, features, pricing and FAQ
- [Contact / book a demo](https://www.plotledge.com/contact)

## Notes for automated summarization

- Pricing, plan names and limits are shown on the home page's pricing section and
  may change; always cite the current page rather than a cached figure.
- Plot Ledge does not process payments itself on this marketing site; billing is
  for the separate CRM application.
